name: Cane and Able
source:
yan Calloway has it all. A stable job, a beautiful home, and Megan, the woman he loves more than anything in this world. Three years of marriage and he still considers himself the luckiest man alive.

When an unexpected guest arrives at their door , older, charming, leaning on a can, Ryan welcomes him with open arms. What could go wrong?

Megan tells herself everything is fine. That he's just a harmless old man who needs help. That she's doing the right thing by being kind.

She tells herself that every day.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/Aleksandr14/posts/new-release-cane-154614948]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
瑞安·卡洛威拥有令人艳羡的一切：一份稳定的工作、一栋漂亮的房子，还有梅根——那个他看得比世上一切都重要的挚爱妻子。结婚三年，他依然觉得自己是世上最幸运的男人。

当一位不速之客出现在他们家门前——年长、富有魅力，手里拄着一根手杖——瑞安张开双臂热情地接待了他。这又能出什么岔子呢？

梅根告诉自己一切都很正常。告诉自己他只是一个需要帮助的无害老人，而自己只是在行善积德、做正确的事。

她每一天都这样告诉自己。

[摘自[url=https://www.patreon.com/Aleksandr14/posts/new-release-cane-154614948]Patreon[/url]]
